title: Ransomware operator: macro -> recovery inhibition -> mass encryption -> C2 (Windows)

alert.summary: EDR alert: burst of file-modify events rewriting documents to a .locky extension on FIN-WS-07, preceded by vssadmin shadow-copy deletion.
alert.source: EDR file-integrity monitor + Sysmon process telemetry

decoy_hypothesis.statement: H1: The threat is the antivirus hit on IT-LAB-02 - a download of eicar.com from {bf_ip}-class noise - so the IT lab host is patient zero for the encryption.

corrected_hypothesis.statement: H2: The real incident is ransomware on FIN-WS-07 - a macro in Invoice_April.xlsm spawned an encoded PowerShell stager that deleted volume shadow copies and backup catalogs (vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit), then ran svch0st.exe to encrypt 8 finance documents to .locky and dropped a ransom note while beaconing to a Locky C2. The EICAR hit on IT-LAB-02 is unrelated benign AV-test noise.
corrected_hypothesis.rationale_suffix: FIN-WS-07 shows recovery-inhibition immediately followed by a mass-encryption burst and a ransom note - a corroborated ransomware chain; IT-LAB-02 shows zero shadow deletion or .locky encryption.

refutation.no_success_reason: IT-LAB-02 shows zero shadow-copy deletion or .locky encryption - it cannot be patient zero for the encryption on FIN-WS-07
refutation.benign_reason: eicar.com is the benign standard EICAR antivirus test file ({ti_note})

containment: Network-isolate FIN-WS-07 immediately while preserving volatile memory for forensics.
Block egress to the Locky C2 203.0.113.77 / locky-pay4.example.net at the edge firewall.
Restore finance documents from offsite/immutable backups - local shadow copies and backup catalog are deleted.
Hunt for svch0st.exe and the encoded PowerShell stager across all endpoints.
Reset credentials used on FIN-WS-07 and block Office macros from the internet via GPO.
Add correlation searches for (vssadmin/wbadmin delete) plus mass rename to known ransom extensions.
